newsitem.title: ITALY: Avalanche kills one skier in northwest Italy.
newsitem.headline: Avalanche kills one skier in northwest Italy.

text.p: One skier was killed and six others were slightly injured on Saturday when an avalanche came crashing down on an Alpine ski area in northwest Italy, police said.
A huge piece of a glacier broke off and slammed into the slopes of the Courmayeur ski area, which was packed with hundreds of skiers taking advantage of sunny weather.
Police said the victim, whose identity was not immediately known, was crushed against a tree by the avalanche.
The injured were airlifed by helicopter to Courmayeur where they were being treated for minor injuries.
